PEO.description: formulate innovative solutions to complex computing problems and requirements using the principles of research, mathematics and computing sciences; engage in corporate and community-based advocacies that address social problems to positively impact the society; contribute to the advancement of the computer science discipline by augmenting existing domain knowledge; and exemplify Christian values in the practice of one's computing profession while working ethically and with integrity.

PLO.description: integrate knowledge of computing, science, mathematics and other domains in the appreciation of the Computer Science discipline; solve real-world computing problems within constraints of time, cost and resources by employing critical thinking skills; apply mathematical foundations, algorithmic principles and computer science theories in the modeling and design of computer-based systems; evaluate solutions and systems for complex computing problems with considerations on public health and safety, cultural, societal and environmental impact; utilize the appropriate tools, techniques and resources in the provision of computing solutions; communicate effectively knowledge and ideas to the computing community and society at large across a wide range of contexts and media; function effectively as an accountable individual and as a team player in a multicultural and multidisciplinary environment; act in accordance with social, legal, and ethical responsibilities as CS professional, with recognition of the local and global impact of technology to individuals, organizations and society; adapt to new and emerging technologies in the pursuit of continuing professional growth; and practice Christian, Louisian and Filipino values in their personal and professional endeavors and actively participate in the service of the community.
